benchmark.title: Salary Data
benchmark.gapExplanation: The gender pay gap represents the percentage difference between the average salary of men and women in a specific occupation. A positive gap indicates that men earn more on average.
benchmark.highGapDescription: In this occupation, women earn considerably less than men on average.
benchmark.methodologyNote: INEGI ENOE data with national representative sample. Monthly net salaries in Mexican pesos.
benchmark.noData: Data not available for this occupation

fitScore.title: What is the Fit Score?
fitScore.explanation: The Fit Score is a 0-100 metric that compares your profile against job requirements. It uses AI to analyze skills, experience, and keywords.

interpretation.medium: 50-79: Good match — highlight your strengths in the interview
interpretation.low: 0-49: Lower match — consider developing missing skills

fitScore.note: Fit Score is a guide, not a rule. Many women get offers with 60-70 scores!
